description: Defines data structures and functions for managing sets of object identifiers, optimized for large lists with emphasis on storage and processing efficiency.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the end of the array, potentially losing order.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs binary search for an object ID; sorts array if not sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees memory and resets the array to empty.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each element, executing a callback.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over unique elements in sorted order, sorting if necessary.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Retains entries for which the callback returns true, preserving order.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array in ascending object ID order.

methods.name: oid_array_next_unique
methods.description: Finds the next unique object ID after a given position in a sorted array.
